sparkcache.root_requirement: Use one dedicated rank-local host directory per physical rank, mounted at the same container path on all four ranks.

evidence.conditions: Historical qualified receipt from four directly cabled NVIDIA DGX Spark systems at TP4/DCP1 using max_model_len=524288, max_num_seqs=32, max_num_batched_tokens=4096, block_size=256, and 34359738368 key-value bytes per rank. It does not qualify the normalized 1048576-token candidate serving object in this recipe.
evidence.result: A cold-cache deterministic prompt of 73,774 tokens committed 73,728 reusable tokens as 288 chunks and 300,908,544 bytes on each of 4 ranks. After a coordinated restart that left the cache roots in place, every rank discovered its manifest and restored in 483.9, 413.9, 443.0, 494.6 ms. The repeated prompt served 73,728 external-cache hit tokens of 73,814 queried and returned SPARKCACHE_OK:9540; the post-restore canary returned SPARKCACHE_CANARY_OK.
evidence.conclusion: The historical 524288-token composition restored durable prefix state across a coordinated engine restart and continued generating correct output. The normalized candidate retains those artifacts and cache policies but requires a fresh live gate at 1048576 tokens.
limitations: The published qualification receipt used a 4096-token scheduler budget. Operators may choose other values; 8192 is known to work, but its performance and capacity behavior is outside this receipt.
The qualified receipt covers a 524288-token context; the current 1048576-token target is candidate.
The 34359738368-byte reservation, 32-sequence limit, block size 256, and 4096-token scheduler budget carry forward unchanged, but capacity at the larger context must be measured.
The complete checkpoint manifest is generated from the pinned revision and must reproduce the recorded digest. A different digest is a different composition and does not reproduce this qualification.
The published receipt covers DeepSeek DCP1, not DCP2 or DCP4.
This recipe disables streaming snapshots and SparkCache CUDA restore; the published receipt does not cover either mode.
evidence.artifact_scope: The exact SparkCache wheel, runtime image, checkpoint identity, topology, and historical max_model_len=524288 serving values stated in evidence.conditions.
